# `nlink-lab fmt`

## Reference

<!-- cli-ref:start (generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit) -->

```text
Format NLL files: canonical indentation and spacing, nothing else.

A token-level formatter: comments, blank-line structure, quoting and statement order are kept; only whitespace changes, so the topology is guaranteed identical. `--check` for CI, `-w` to rewrite in place, `-` to format stdin.

Usage: nlink-lab fmt [OPTIONS] <PATH>...

Arguments:
  <PATH>...
          Files or directories (recursed for `*.nll`). `-` reads stdin

Options:
      --check
          Exit 2 and list the files that would change; write nothing

  -w, --write
          Rewrite files in place (default prints the result to stdout)

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

<!-- cli-ref:end -->
